READ THE FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS THROUGH COMPLETELY AT LEAST ONCE REFORE ATTEMPTING TO INSTALL THE DECAL(S) THEY CONCERN! !

THE DECAL(S) ARE COMPOSED OF THREE (3) PARTS: 1)A HEAVY WAXED RACKING SHEET WHICH COVERS THE STICKY SIDE OF THE DECAL, 2) THE DECAL ITSELF, AND 3)A THIN MASKING SHEET WHICH 1S ON THE FRONT SIDE OF THE DECAL TO PROTECT IT AND TO AID IN 3TS INSTALLATION,

1, BE SURE THE AREA WHERE YOU ARE GOING TO APPLY THE DECAL 1S CLEAN AND FREE OF ALL DIRT, GREASE, AND GRIME.
?. USING ANY SPRAY=O0N GLASS CLEANER, THOROUGHLY WET DOWN THE AREA WHERE YOU INTEND TO PUT THE DECAL.

3. REMOVE THE HEAVY WAXED RACKING SHEET FROM THE DECAL RY POSITIONING JT FACE UP ON A FLAT SURFACE; GOING TO ANY CORNER; AND RENDING THIS CORNER UP SLIGHTLY TO SEPARATE THE DECAL AND THIN MASKING SHEET FROM THE HEAVY WAXED BACKING SHEET.
4 SLOWLY AND CAREFULLY PEEL THE HEAVY WAXED RACKING SHEET AWAY FROM THE DECAL AND MASKING SHEET.

6. SMOOTH THE DECAL.
